postContent: WE ARE HIRING | ASSISTANT MANAGER – FINANCE (ACCOUNTS PAYABLE & VENDOR PAYMENTS) COGENT Infotech | Remote – India | US EST Shift COGENT Infotech is looking for an experienced and commercially aware Assistant Manager – Finance with strong expertise in US Accounts Payable, C2C Vendor Payments, and 1099 Contractor Payments. We are seeking a proactive professional who can independently manage end-to-end AP operations, vendor relationships, payment tracking, and financial reconciliations while coordinating with US-based clients and vendors. Position Details: Job Title: Assistant Manager – Finance Experience: 8–10 Years Location: Remote – India Shift: US EST Shift Employment Type: Full-Time Key Responsibilities: Manage end-to-end US Accounts Payable operations. Handle C2C vendor and 1099 contractor payments. Review and validate vendor invoices, timesheets, contracts, SOWs, and payment terms. Track outstanding payments and coordinate with clients for timely collections. Release vendor payments based on corresponding client payment receipts. Maintain vendor accounts, payment records, and financial reconciliations. Resolve vendor queries, payment disputes, and escalations. Ensure accuracy and compliance in AP documentation and financial records. What We're Looking For: Strong hands-on experience in US Accounts Payable. Understanding of US staffing and IT consulting finance operations. Expertise in C2C vendor payments and 1099 contractor payments. Working knowledge of QuickBooks, Tally, and MS Excel. Strong understanding of contracts, SOWs, timesheets, and payment terms. Excellent communication, negotiation, and vendor management skills. Ability to independently manage payment follow-ups and vendor relationships. Interested candidates can share their updated resumes at arpana.bharti@cogentinfo.com or connect with me directly on LinkedIn.

We're Hiring: Cash Flow Accountant Company: QMCC (Quanta Metrics Consulting) Location: Remote – Pakistan Working Hours: Two available shifts: - Morning: 11:00 AM – 3:00 PM - Evening: 8:00 PM – 12:00 AM Job Summary QMCC is looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Cash Flow Accountant to manage cash flow monitoring, financial reporting, and cash management activities. The ideal candidate should have strong accounting knowledge, excellent Excel skills, and the ability to maintain accurate financial records while supporting effective financial planning. Key Responsibilities - Monitor daily cash inflows and outflows and maintain cash flow statements. - Prepare cash flow forecasts and projections. - Track accounts receivable and accounts payable. - Monitor bank balances, transactions, and cash positions. - Reconcile bank statements and investigate discrepancies. - Maintain accurate financial records and cash flow reports. - Identify potential cash shortages or surpluses and highlight financial risks. - Assist with budgeting, financial planning, and reporting. - Coordinate with relevant departments to ensure timely financial updates. Requirements - Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. - 2–4 years of experience in accounting, cash flow management, or financial reporting. - Strong knowledge of cash flow statements and financial reconciliation. - Advanced Microsoft Excel skills. - Familiarity with accounting software such as QuickBooks, Xero, or Sage. - Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. - Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
